steps.cde: To the right of {c} come {d} and {e}: the three white keys around the group of two black keys.
steps.playCde: Play the notes as they reach the keyboard. The music waits for you.
steps.fgab: Around the group of three black keys are {f}, {g}, {a} and {b}. After {b}, the next {c} starts the pattern again.
steps.walkUpDown: Walk up the white keys from middle {c} to the next {c}, then back down.
